print.guide.step1: Scan the QR code shown in the kiosk to open the upload page on your device.
print.guide.step2: Upload your document file(s) from your device.
print.guide.step3: Press "Send to Kiosk" to transfer your file(s) to the kiosk.
print.guide.step4: Wait for the upload to complete. If it is successful, please check in the kiosk to review your file(s).
print.guide.step5: Your uploaded file(s) will appear on the kiosk screen. Review your file(s) and press "Proceed to Config" for the next step.
print.guide.step6: Configure your print settings (e.g. number of copies, color or black & white) and then press "Continue" for confirmation step and to insert coins.
print.guide.step7: You may now proceed to insert coins. Press "Confirm & Print" and wait for the printing to start.
copy.guide.step1: Place your document face-down first on the scanner glass. If it is ready, press "Check Document" on the kiosk screen to preview the scan.
copy.guide.step2: Please wait for your document to finish scanning.
copy.guide.step3: Review the scanned preview on the screen. If it is correct, press "Continue to Config" for the next step.
copy.guide.step4: Select your preferred copy settings (size, color, copies) and proceed.
copy.guide.step5: Insert the required coins for your copy job and confirm payment.
copy.guide.step6: Wait for the copying to finish and collect your documents.
scan.guide.step1: Place your document in the printer document feeder. If it is ready, press "Scan Document".
scan.guide.step2: Your physical document is feeding into the printer. Please wait for it to finish scanning.
scan.guide.step3: Your scanned document will appear on the kiosk screen. Review the preview.
scan.guide.step4: Insert the required coins for your scan job and confirm payment.
scan.guide.step5: After confirmation, the kiosk generates the image QR code link to download as soft copy.
